resources.string: Deployment
These are declared planning settings. They do not deploy anything or establish approval, regional support, capacity or readiness.
Environment
Choose a frozen environment value, or leave it not supplied. No environment is selected automatically.
Minimum replicas
Optional whole number, at least 0. Zero is a supplied value. No relationship to maximum replicas is inferred here.
Maximum replicas
Optional whole number, at least 1. This is a declared bound, not verified available capacity.
Region
Optional literal text; blank, whitespace and unknown remain declared input. This does not verify a region or its availability.
Approval ticket reference
Optional unverified reference text. It grants no approval or access. Do not enter credentials or authorization tokens.
Not supplied
Supply %1$s
Enter a whole number, or clear Supply to leave this field not supplied.
Use an exact JSON whole number with a dot for any decimal notation; do not use grouping, locale separators or units.
Choose one of the listed environments, or Not supplied.
